correctness.rationale: The stated all-interacting opinion diameter remains invariant by convex averaging. The FOAF polynomial vector field preserves the weight cube and initial block structure; induction on initial graph distance shows all preceding coefficients vanish and that every shortest path contributes once per internal split, giving exactly the claimed coefficient. Monotonicity and logistic comparison establish strict positive-time activation, asymptotic saturation and unique threshold crossings. The self-contained exact-rational recurrence verifies 4,832 finite identities; the general claim is established by the analytical argument.

value.rationale: For a published sociological model whose structure evolution was proposed for further study, this identifies an intrinsic, non-arbitrary dynamical hierarchy across all finite weighted networks. Exact componentwise positive-time completion, distance-dependent vanishing order, multiplicity-sensitive weighted geodesic coefficient and associated threshold scaling distinguish algebraic link existence from meaningful link strength. It motivates physically interpretable early link formation without asserting stronger opinion-convergence claims.
